provenance: 830 corridor machinery (importlib, unmodified) on a 366d-back-padded panel; ALL numbers are eval-slice only; universe = 830-pattern liquidity-filtered daily panel (NOT the fold's 64) — same yardstick caveat as 835 SPEC #10. Daily source: fixture daily == db daily (LEDGER 830/E0-REAL).
slice_convention: corridor slice = backtest half-open [eval_start, eval_end) on UTC-midnight day_ts; the daily panel load is end-EXCLUSIVE, so the last graded corridor decision is eval_end-2d (the final panel row only labels the previous decision). The 835 fold scorecard's minute loader is end-INCLUSIVE at LOCAL midnight and consumes window_size (60) rows of the eval panel for obs warmup: its graded decisions run ~eval_start+60d .. ~eval_end-1d. SIGN of the mismatch: the corridor covers ~60 MORE daily decisions at the LEFT edge and ~1 FEWER at the RIGHT edge (tz skew <=1d). Neither instrument ever touches data past eval_end. Documented (SPEC §corridor), not tuned.
